text_block_list.text:
—The Nihon Derby. A festival where the 
rising stars of the generation gather to 
compete. Naturally, the rivals who fought 
for the Satsuki crown were there as well.

text_block_list.text:

have a premonition: she could become an 
ally in toppling the "Golden 
Generation"...
